column3: Bilingual pairing record: one hash per heading section for the workflow group map README (7 sections), regenerated by verify-translation-pairing.
Group map: names the three workflow packages (workflow seam / workflow-ptc engine / tool-workflow consumer) and the ctx key each registers on.
Chinese mirror of the workflow group map; line-parallel 53-line translation of the package table and related-doc links.
Five-line English locale: meta.title only ("tool-workflow").
Chinese locale: meta.title 工作流工具 plus a meta.description that is stale (says tool operations, the tool orchestrates subagents).
Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow 0.2.1-rc.2; exports ., ./types, ./src/*, ./locale/*; only runtime dep is schemastery.
Per-section bilingual hash record for the tool README, 40 heading paths down to the Model Experience subsections.
Package reference for the model-facing workflow tool: call shape, foreground/background envelopes, exact rendered strings, config table, Model Experience with Token/KV-cache effects.
Chinese mirror of the tool README (186 lines, line-parallel); preserves the model-facing English strings verbatim inside the Chinese prose.
The model-facing `workflow` tool: schema + description, foreground lifecycle with abort bridge, background job registration, durable session recorder, generic presentation card.
Live-progress mirror routing workflow/phase, workflow/log and member events into a background job's output ring on the log channel (observer-only for the model).
The four log-only durable session event payloads (run-start, agent-start, agent-end, run-end) and their SessionEventMap declaration.

Full tool suite: StubEngine, foreground lifecycle, exact durable-record sequence, first-append-failure prefix table, abort bridge, truncation, HMR, background job path against a real LocalJobRegistry.
TS project config; references schemastery, core/tools, core/system-prompt, jobs/jobs and ../workflow — the tool's contract surface.
Five-line English locale: meta.title only ("workflow-ptc").
Chinese locale: meta.title 工作流执行引擎 plus a meta.description that describes the tool rather than the engine.
Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc 0.2.1-rc.2; publishes lib/index.js plus lib/types/**/*.d.ts only (no lib/types js), so the JS is bundled and the declarations come from tsc.
Per-section bilingual hash record for the PTC engine README, 37 heading paths including the three-level Model Experience nesting.
Package reference for the PTC engine: config table, results/failures, separate capture of cwd and file policy, no overall deadline, VM-is-not-a-security-boundary limitation.
Chinese mirror of the PTC engine README; 169 lines, line-parallel with the English including the known-limitations list.

GENERATED artifact: the whole workflow guest bundled by scripts/gen-workflow-guest.ts into one self-contained ESM string (8 inlined regions); read in full by decoding the escapes — it is the type-stripped twin of runtime.ts + guest.ts + realm.ts plus brand/llm-error/util-values/json-schema helpers.
The five-function JSON host surface (begin, startChild, childResult, disposeChild, progress) plus the WorkflowProgress event union and the host-allocated callId addressing.
Guest adapter: batches progress with exactly one batch in flight, drains before child disposal and before the terminal result, and fails the run if a progress batch is rejected.
Host side of the PTC engine: PTC execution, child ownership and publication races, strict re-validation of every inbound binding value, cancellation ordering and disposal quiescence.
The PTC engine plugin: config, meta validation, host-side body parse, provider/limit resolution (0 = auto concurrency, per-run cap may only lower), captured service handles, workflow/* emission.
Meta validation: rejects unknown fields by name, collects EVERY violation into one throw, and returns a normalized copy so the engine never aliases the caller's object.
Lossless-JSON materialization across the VM realm (path-qualified errors, defineProperty for __proto__, cycles rejected but DAGs accepted) plus a total renderThrown that never throws.
VM evaluation and the five hooks: fatal-vs-per-item-null combinator discipline, contain() no-op rejection consumer, FIFO concurrency slots, agent() option subset validation and the caps.
Guest input types: WorkerLimits, WorkerInit, ChildStartRequest, ChildResult (stopReason degraded to string on the wire), ChildHandle and ChildPort.
Proves the PUBLISHED artifact: skips unless lib/ exists, writes a driver.mjs importing the package by name, runs a structured child and a blocked outside-workspace write.
Proves the program-visible environment is empty by escaping the VM via constructor.constructor('return process')().env with proxy/env canaries stubbed in.
Guest-side suite: progress batching pinned numerically (200 logs = 2 batches, peak 1 in flight), child-result semantics, option validation, VM timeout, and the sourceURL stack check under plain Node.
Host-callback contract suite: a table of twelve malformed binding payloads, sandbox-policy forwarding, cwd retention after the parent moves, and settlement-vs-cleanup ordering.

Real in-process stack test: two-phase workflow with a prose and a schema child; asserts the parent gets no followup/steer, children are announced only after publication, and no child agent stays live.
Unit tests for validateMeta: no-aliasing, every-violation-at-once, unknown-field rejection, and per-phase field validation with indexed paths.
Unit tests for the materializer and renderer: getter trust premise, __proto__ pollution check, cycles vs DAGs, sparse arrays, exotic prototypes, and JSON round-trip losslessness.
Composition helpers mounting the REAL Node PTC stack (sessions, agents, fs, subprocess, sandbox, sandbox-policy, ptc-runtime) with a temp root removed in onTestFinished.
Source-runtime smoke across both execution modes, including an OS-level write through the constructor escape proving workspace-write confinement and blocked outside writes.
With-key e2e against the real DeepSeek adapter (skipped without DEEPSEEK_API_KEY): two real children, world-check assertions, both children disposed afterwards.

The engine's largest suite: scripted StubProvider over the real SubagentRuntime, provider routing and cap rules, the full cancellation/termination matrix, publication races, and engine-unload survival.
TS project config; references subagent, core/tools, ptc-runtime, sandbox, sandbox-policy and working-directory — the confinement chain the engine sits on.
Bundler config: entry lib/types/index.js, esm, node, es2024, dts false, clean false (declarations come from tsc and must survive the bundle).
Manifest for @deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow 0.2.1-rc.2, a types-only seam package: publishes lib/index.js and lib/types only, peers on agent/brand/llm/session/cordis.
Per-section bilingual hash record for the seam README, 30 heading paths including the nested known-limitations/dev-note path.
Package reference for the seam: start() contract, the five script hooks, failure discipline (hook misuse kills loudly, ordinary child failure is null), and the stated limitations.
Chinese mirror of the seam README (142 lines, line-parallel); adds explicitly that loading a second engine fails loudly.
The seam: abstract WorkflowEngine service, six workflow/* event declarations, the closed WorkflowErrorCode taxonomy with a fatal flag, and per-listener total containment in emitWorkflowEvent.
Host-only WorkflowStartRequest (script, meta, args, provider/agent overrides, parent, signal) and the WorkflowRun handle whose result never rejects and whose dispose is idempotent.
Browser-safe vocabulary: branded WorkflowRunId, WorkflowMeta/Phase, closed WorkflowStopReason, WorkflowResult, and the event payload shapes (WorkflowResultInfo deliberately omits the value).
Interface tests: brand identity, error taxonomy, service register/unregister on fiber dispose, and listener containment including an unrenderable thrown value.
TS project config emitting types only into lib/types; references cordis, core/agent, core/session, util/brand and llm/llm.
